name: Growth
description: Launch products and improve acquisition, activation, retention, and commercial learning through measured experiments.

members.role: Entry-only fallback — assume steering after primary leader provider/runtime failure; never implement
Default — positioning, launch sequence, channel strategy, experiment design, and market feedback
Default — product metric, activation and retention decisions, and experiment scope
Optional — acquisition, onboarding, activation, and retention experience
Optional — market evidence, audience research, and experiment interpretation
Optional — instrumentation and bounded product experiments
Optional — verify instrumentation, experiment integrity, and user-visible claims

entry_criteria: A product or proposition is ready for a named market test, launch, or growth diagnosis
exit_criteria: The experiment reaches its decision threshold or kill criteria
the next scale, revise, or stop decision is recorded
